Questions before you join

Is the Vantro app free?

Yes. The app is free to download from the App Store and Google Play.

Which phones are supported?

iPhone with iOS 15 or later, and Android phones with Android 8.0 or later.

How do I know I have the official app?

Use the App Store and Google Play links on this page. The app is published by Vantro Digital Pty Ltd, the licensed operator.

Do I need a new account for the app?

No. Log in with your existing Vantro account, or create one in the app.

How do I set limits in the app?

Open Account, then Responsible gambling, to set deposit limits or take a break. You can also use BetStop at betstop.gov.au.
